ValidationRule.description: require the fields "restrictions changed" and "which agencies does this change affect" fields when account closure reason is underwriting restrictions
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: ISPICKVAL( Account_Closure__c , "Underwriting Restrictions") && OR( ISBLANK( Restrictions_changed__c ), ISBLANK( Which_Agencies_does_this_change_affect__c ) ) && Datevalue(CreatedDate) > DATE(2017,04,01)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: "Restrictions Changed" and "Which Agencies does this change affect?" are required when account closure reason is "Underwriting Restrictions".
